one.title: Add your materials and brick mix
one.body: Enter what is in the yard today and how much of each goes into 1,000 bricks.

two.title: Add your team
two.body: Give logins to those who use the app. Labourers are kept as staff for attendance and wages — no login needed.

three.title: Record the day
three.body: Bricks made, sales and attendance. The app does the counting, stock and reminders.

hindi.a: Yes. Every screen is in English and Hindi, and names can be saved in both. Each person picks their own language.

gst.a: No. Without GST you get a simple bill. If you are registered, invoices show CGST and SGST, or IGST for other states.

phone.a: No. It works on any smartphone and can be added to the home screen like an app. It also works on a computer.

labour.a: No. Supervisors mark their attendance and wages. Only people who use the app themselves need a login.

many.q: I run more than one plant. Can I use it?
many.a: Yes. Each company's data is kept completely separate, and each has its own admins, staff and settings.

data.a: On your own server, with password-locked backups every night. It can move to the cloud later without changes.

price.a: It depends on the size of your plant and how many people will use it. Book a demo and we will share a quote.

cta.title: See it with your own plant's numbers
cta.body: A short demo on a call. We set up your materials, brick types and a few customers so you can see your own yard in the app.

materials.title: Raw material stock
materials.body: Fly ash, cement, stone dust, lime, gypsum and anything else — with gauges, purchases, adjustments and a days-left forecast.

recipe.title: Brick mix (recipe)
recipe.body: Set how much of each material goes into 1,000 bricks of each type. Production takes it out automatically.

production.title: Daily production
production.body: Good and broken bricks per type and day, with the defect rate and a void that reverses everything.

stock.title: Brick stock
stock.body: Live stock per brick type, "can make N more" from current material, and the full movement history.

sales.title: Sales
sales.body: Bills with several lines, delivery, discount and the price per brick for each sale. Stock goes down automatically.

invoices.title: Invoices with or without GST
invoices.body: CGST/SGST or IGST worked out from the customer's state, numbered per financial year, amount in words in English or Hindi.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Found by any of their phone numbers, with everything they bought, paid and still owe.

dues.title: Money to collect
dues.body: Part payments over time, every pending amount, and how many days it has been waiting.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: One tap per worker per day: present, half day, absent, leave or holiday, with overtime and bricks made.

wages.title: Wages & payments
wages.body: Daily, monthly or per-brick wages, advances, bonuses and deductions, and a chart of money paid over time.

logins.title: Logins & access
logins.body: Only admins create logins. Each section can be none, view or edit, per person. Temporary passwords expire in 3 days.

dashboard.title: Dashboard & charts
dashboard.body: Today's figures, quick actions and charts you can open full screen, tap for details, with plain-language insights.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: Low stock, new sales, payments and old dues — in the app, by email, SMS or WhatsApp. Tap to open the record.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.body: Every change, by whom and when, plus sign-in history for every login.

backups.title: Backups & export
backups.body: Password-locked backups every night, a download any time, and copies by email if you want them.

languages.title: English & Hindi
languages.body: Every screen in both. Names in both scripts, filled in automatically as you type.

phone.title: Phone first, works on computers
phone.body: Installs on the home screen like an app. Big buttons, clear words, and it keeps working on a weak connection.

comfort.title: Comfortable to read
comfort.body: Light and dark mode, larger text, bold text, and cartoon pictures for every worker until a photo is added.

security.title: Built to keep your business data safe
security.subtitle: Your sales, dues and wages are private. Here is how the app protects them — in plain words.

access.title: Each person sees only what you allow
access.body: For every section — materials, sales, staff and more — choose none, view or edit for each employee. Nobody can give themselves more.

company.title: Every company is separate
company.body: If you run more than one plant, each company's data is kept apart. One company can never see another's.

logins.title: No public sign-up
logins.body: Only an admin can create a login. New people get a temporary password that must be changed and expires in 3 days.

sessions.title: Instant control over logins
sessions.body: Disable someone and they are out on their next tap. Anyone can sign out of all their devices in one go.

attempts.title: Guessing is stopped
attempts.body: Repeated wrong passwords are slowed down and recorded. Every sign-in shows its time and device.

activity.title: Every change is recorded
activity.body: The activity log shows who changed what and when — sales, payments, stock, wages and access.

backups.title: Locked backups every night
backups.body: Backups are encrypted with your password before they are saved or emailed. Photos are left out to keep them small.

hosting.title: On your own server
hosting.body: The app runs on a server you control, over HTTPS. It can move to the cloud later without changes.

never: Show ads or sell your data
Track your visitors with third-party scripts
Store pages or business data on a shared phone after sign-out
